title: Standard Paid Time Off Policy
content:
# Paid Time Off
Full-time employees receive 18 days of paid leave annually.
Contact HR at hr-pto@company.org or John Doe (555-101-0001).

title: Bereavement Leave Guidelines
content:
# Bereavement Leave
Employees are eligible for up to 5 consecutive paid days off for the death of an immediate family member.

title: Parental Leave and Child Bonding
content:
# Parental Leave
Eligible employees receive 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave within 12 months of birth or adoption.

title: Health and Dental Insurance Overview
content:
# Health Insurance
Medical coverage starts on the first day of employment. Dental and vision benefits are fully covered.

title: Remote Work and Home Office Equipment
content:
# Remote Work
Remote employees are entitled to a $500 initial home office stipend. Contact it-support@company.org.

title: Tuition Reimbursement and Education Assistance
content:
# Tuition Assistance
Employees may receive up to $5,250 per calendar year for approved degree courses. Submit to Alice Smith at 555-101-0006.

title: Employee Code of Business Conduct
content:
# Code of Conduct
All employees must act ethically, maintain confidentiality, and report conflicts of interest.

title: Holidays and Floating Days Schedule
content:
# Corporate Holidays
The company observes 11 standard public holidays plus 2 floating personal days annually.

title: Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Policy
content:
# Disability Coverage
Short-term disability provides up to 60% of base salary for qualifying medical absences up to 26 weeks.

title: 401k Retirement Plan and Match Schedule
content:
# 401(k) Plan
Company matches 100% of employee contributions up to 4% of total compensation with immediate vesting.

title: Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) Protocol
content:
# PIP Protocols
Managers must draft a formal 30, 60, or 90 day improvement plan with weekly documented check-ins.

title: Manager Hiring and Interview Rubrics
content:
# Interview Rubrics
Structured competency rubrics are mandatory for technical and cultural fit evaluation.

title: Departmental Travel and Expense Approvals
content:
# Travel Approvals
Department managers may approve lodging up to $250/night and daily meals up to $75 without VP sign-off.

title: Merit Promotion and Salary Adjustment Guidelines
content:
# Promotions
Annual merit cycle reviews take place in Q3. Promoted employees typically receive 8% to 15% salary adjustments.

title: Disciplinary Procedures and Warning Documentation
content:
# Disciplinary Steps
Progressive discipline sequence: verbal consultation, written counseling, final warning, termination.

title: Executive Compensation Structure
content:
# Executive Compensation
Executive tier packages include equity vesting on a 4-year schedule with 1-year cliff. Confidential.

title: Harassment and Discrimination Investigation Protocol
content:
# Investigation Protocol
Formal complaints must initiate an independent investigation within 24 hours. Contact hr-legal@company.org.

title: Employee Severance and Separation Benefits
content:
# Severance Schedules
Severance offers are calculated as two weeks base pay per year of accredited service, minimum 4 weeks.

title: Corporate Regulatory Compliance Filings
content:
# Regulatory Compliance
Mandatory annual OSHA, EEO-1, and DOL reporting schedules. Managed exclusively by HR Compliance officers.
